items.headline: German and Russian Foreign Ministers Hold First Direct Meeting Since 2022
items.summary: On the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul and Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov met for their first high-level talks since Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine. The milestone meeting focused on the war in Ukraine, bilateral relations, and securing Black Sea grain export routes to ease global food shortages.

items.headline: US and China Agree to Establish Communication Channel for AI Incidents
items.summary: Following high-level talks in Washington, the United States and China agreed to establish a bilateral communication channel to manage potential artificial intelligence incidents and safety risks. This initiative represents a key effort by the world's two largest economies to coordinate on technology safeguards amidst growing global AI competition.

items.headline: George Russell Wins Drama-Filled 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix in Baku
items.summary: Mercedes driver George Russell converted his pole position into victory at the 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix after holding off Red Bull's Max Verstappen in Baku. The high-stakes race featured multiple safety car restarts and late-race drama, delivering one of the most exciting Formula 1 finishes of the season.

items.headline: Mike Leigh's 'Tender Loving Care' Wins Top Prize at San Sebastián Film Festival
items.summary: British filmmaker Mike Leigh's social drama 'Tender Loving Care' won the Golden Shell for best film at the 74th San Sebastián International Film Festival on Saturday. The award is especially meaningful because the 83-year-old director has stated this is likely his final film due to health issues.
